Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo this week — StratoHealth's finance and procurement teams asked me to follow up with a formal ask: they want to purchase through AWS Private Offers and are asking for a single-year commitment with the following commercial profile:

- $1.2M committed for 12 months (annualized).
- 35% list discount to published rates (applied at checkout).
- Rev-share to AWS at 18% (we understand standard is 30%).
- Net 60 payment terms (finance requirement).
- Data residency requirement: US-only region.

They can provide SOC2 and a short vendor assessment. They'd like a private offer link and a term sheet by end of next week to move to legal review.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate the rev-share carveout and extended payment terms? If there are trade-offs (credits, onboarding fees, or calendar amortization), please outline them.

Best,

1) Are we able to list a private offer on AWS with rev-share set to 18% (below standard)?

Sean — quick financial read:

- Revenue / margin: $1.2M ACV at 35% off reduces Redwood gross ARR relative to list; with AWS fee at 18% our net take is ~ (1 - 0.18) * (1 - 0.35) = ~53.7% of list. That's tight but workable for a strategic reference customer in healthcare.
- CAC / commission: At this discount and payment terms, partner and AE commission will need to be carved out; recommend applying a 40% commission holdback and accelerating onboarding services fees to offset cash flow hit.
- Payment terms: Net60 materially impacts cash conversion. Recommend offering net60 but with a 2% early-pay credit if paid within 14 days, or a $50k onboarding fee collected at execution to improve cash flow.
- Rev-share: AWS 18% is below platform standard (we typically surface 28–32%). Lowering AWS share requires either an AWS AM exception or subsidizing the delta via an upfront credit on our side — effectively reducing Redwood net.

Recommendation (internal):
- Approve private offer listing provided StratoHealth accepts a $50k onboarding fee OR a 2% early-pay incentive;
- Approve 30% discount cap (ask for 35% but approve up to 30% unless CRO signs off);
- Do NOT reduce AWS rev-share below 25% without Director-level (Marissa) + CRO signoff; if AWS insists on 18% we need executive approval to absorb the difference or route via partner solution.

I'll prepare the term sheet draft showing two options (A: 30% discount + $50k onboarding fee; B: 35% discount + 2% early-pay credit + exec-approved rev-share subsidy). See draft attached (20261121-strato-privoffer-term-sheet-draft.pdf).

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Agree with Marissa's read. From deal-desk perspective:

- We can technically submit a private listing with an AWS rev-share flag, but zero ability to unilaterally change what AWS ultimately accepts; their marketplace terms require AM engagement. If AWS accepts a lower rev-share we need written confirmation.
- For net60, finance will accept if onboarding fee or early-pay credit is implemented — that mitigates risk.
- Approvals needed: Marissa (Revenue Ops) can clear up to 30% discount and up to a 25% rev-share to AWS. Any deeper concessions require CRO or CFO signoff.

Next steps I'm requesting:
1) Marissa to finalize option A/B in the term sheet and mark the one that doesn't need CRO signoff.
2) Sean to route the chosen option to the AWS AM and ask for written acceptance of the 25% rev-share (or confirmation that 18% is acceptable).
3) Laura to prepare minimal legal language to document onboarding fee and early-pay credit; include Data Residency clause (US-only).

I'll queue the deal in Deal Desk with ID DL-78923 and note the required approvals.

Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Emily / Team — thanks for the clear ask and for the SOC2 stub. Quick update on our side after internal review: attached is a private-offer term sheet with two viable options and the trade-offs (see attached).

Option A (no exec subsidy):
- ACV: $1.2M (12 months)
- Discount: 30% off list
- AWS rev-share: 25% (we will ask AWS AM to confirm in writing)
- Payment: Net 60 with $50k onboarding fee due at execution
- Data residency: US-only

Option B (exec subsidy, requires CRO signoff):
- ACV: $1.2M (12 months)
- Discount: 35% off list
- AWS rev-share: AWS requested 18% — Redwood would absorb the delta; requires CRO approval to proceed
- Payment: Net 60 with 2% early-pay credit if paid within 14 days
- Data residency: US-only

Ask: Please confirm whether StratoHealth prefers Option A or B. If Option A is acceptable we'll request written confirmation from the AWS AM that 25% rev-share can be listed; if StratoHealth prefers Option B we will escalate to CRO for approval and then route to AWS.

I've attached the term sheet and SOC2 stub for legal review (see attachments). If you approve Option A I can have our deal desk create the private listing and send a DocuSign by Tuesday for signature.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
